answers.core: The Advance Expression feature already has an interface, I think this proposal makes sense as core since it seeks to increase the quality of an already existing core feature.
answers.workaround: I suppose I could try to open all the .tmp files in an external code editor and try to make the edits that I want with the features present in that editor, but those files aren't very readable, and I worry about potentially corrupting them.

title: Add More Editing Functionality to AnimationTree's Advance Expression Interface
